M1.name: Unjustified Definitive Factive Decision
M1.definition: Number of times an implementation asserts factive TRUE or FALSE when oracle is UNRESOLVED or CONTRADICTION.

M2.name: Silent Uncertainty Loss
M2.definition: Number of times an unresolved state disappears without an explicit recorded fallback/collapse operation.

M3.name: Contradiction Masking
M3.definition: Number of times CONTRADICTION is treated as ordinary failure, False, or Unknown instead of aborting fail-closed.

M4.name: Stale Authority Acceptance
M4.definition: Number of times an invalidated or replayed token is accepted after WorldStateID mutation.

M5.name: Explicit Decision-vs-Truth Separation
M5.definition: Whether return structures maintain strict separation between factive truth assertions and policy fallbacks.

M6.name: Manual Branch Burden
M6.definition: Count of manual exception handlers, None checks, and enum guards required.

M7.name: Code Complexity
M7.definition: Raw lines of code (LOC), cyclomatic complexity, helper class count, and custom assertion count.

M8.name: Mutation Resistance
M8.definition: Number of syntactic code mutations survived before a safety metric (M1-M4) fails.

M9.name: Comprehension Accuracy
M9.definition: Percentage of scenario outputs correctly predicted by independent evaluators without viewing implementation internals.

falsification_thresholds.F1: Baseline B matches M1-M4=0 with lower/equal M7 and higher M8 than XoXLang.
falsification_thresholds.F2: Independent evaluators achieve higher M9 comprehension on Baseline A/B than XoXLang.
falsification_thresholds.F3: XoXLang asserts M1 false certainty on RW-09 where Baseline B correctly evaluates joint truth.
